name: never-serve-broken-deck
body: The server must never present a partially broken deck: if validation fails (startup or reload) — including validation of the resolved library layers (the external library at the configured `templates:` path when set, and the deck-root `templates/` directory when it exists; layered-template-library) — no slides are rendered: startup exits, reload shows the full-page error. A change to the configured `templates:` value while serving counts as serving a broken state: no slides are rendered and the full-page restart-required error is shown instead (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
